rows.target_brief: Narrow residential road from lower-left A to upper-right B.
rows.notes: The lower residential lane is visible, but the middle-to-upper diagonal segment passes beneath broad tree crowns. Both road edges and the full cross-section cannot be followed through those crowns. No hidden edge was inferred.
uncertainties: Tree crowns obscure the full road width and edges between the green-roofed buildings and the approach to B.

rows.target_brief: Residential lane from lower A to upper B, including the full main-road width at side accesses.
rows.notes: The exposed lane and both endpoints were checked at native scale. Palm/tree foliage near the lower-middle approach and vegetation along the upper lane obscure portions of the road margins; the continuous full-width boundary is not reliably recoverable. Shadows alone were not treated as obstacles.
uncertainties: Foliage and dark areas interrupt certainty about the full main-road margin; no crown-hidden boundary was invented.

rows.target_brief: Narrow east-west lane from the A junction to B beside the red-roofed property.
rows.notes: The lane is visible through much of its length, bounded by houses and fenced plots. A tree crown and dark area immediately west of B hide part of the narrow lane and its margins. Full-width continuity there cannot be established without inventing an edge.
uncertainties: The main-road boundary and possible entity overlap under the crown near B remain unknown.

rows.target_brief: North-south residential lane from upper A to lower B.
rows.notes: Native inspection covered A, B, both margins and the intervening lane. The upper lane and multiple middle sections are visible, but palm foliage interrupts some margins and the large crown at the B approach hides the complete roadway cross-section.
uncertainties: The B-end boundary is occluded by a broad crown; its hidden road margins cannot be reliably continued.

rows.target_brief: Lane from western A through the residential strip, bending north-east and then east to B.
rows.notes: The open bent eastern section and both fixed endpoints were inspected. A broad crown over the early residential section hides the lane surface and both margins. A full-segment target polygon cannot be drawn from visible edges; canopy-hidden edges were not fabricated.
uncertainties: The full-width lane beneath the broad crown between A and the first bend is not observable; overlap with the hidden road cannot be delimited.

rows.target_brief: Full main-lane width from western A to eastern B; the lane curves slightly north near the red-roofed property.
rows.notes: Original, guide, native full-segment crop and enlarged detail were inspected, including both endpoints and margins. The pale continuous lane is visible throughout. At adjoining yards, the polygon follows the continuous main-lane width rather than including the forecourt. Nearby stored items and tree shadows do not show a discernible physical intrusion into the lane.
